proposed_from.topic: Entropic zero-set collapse and certified recovery of finite OT moment identified sets. Let two fixed finite alphabets have observed marginals p,q bounded below by eta, let pi range over Pi(p,q), let theta range over a computably covered compact set, and define D0(theta)=min_pi ||sum_ij pi_ij phi_ij(theta)|| for a bounded moment table with a known modulus and a nonempty sharp set Theta0 satisfying a displayed separation exponent kappa. Prove that adding epsilon KL(pi||p tensor q) yields D_epsilon=min_pi{||m_theta(pi)||+epsilon KL} and, for every epsilon>0, exact zero membership iff the product coupling satisfies the moment. Derive the pointwise first-order penalty as minimum KL over D0-minimizing couplings. Construct certified Sinkhorn primal-dual and rational-repair brackets L_a<=D0<=U_a with uniform gap at most a and finite polynomial work in fixed dimensions, then combine them with multinomial confidence events to give finite-sample simultaneous outer coverage of Theta0 and separation-based Hausdorff control on that same event. Credit Franguridi--Liu arXiv:2512.18084v3 for the regularized OT estimator and bootstrap, and generic entropy and criterion-set theory; exclude unconditional two-sided root-rate recovery and the refuted directional-face frontier. Their UAS attrition/refreshment workflow is the consumer, but its published contour is not characterized without a code audit. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: The fresh presolve rederived D_epsilon=min_pi{||m_theta(pi)||+epsilon KL}, exact product-coupling zero-set collapse, and the fixed-instance J=min KL expansion. It solved the binary benefit-share case where [1/2,1] collapses to {3/4}, plus a vector tied-face case. It derived certified original-value brackets, exact marginal repair, an O(a^(-5)) exact-arithmetic per-query stopping bound, marginal stability, and finite-cell simultaneous coverage and Hausdorff control. A reproducible check covered 21 binary cases and 4,500 Sinkhorn iterates over 15 positive 3-by-3 problems against LP values. Destructive checks reproduced the current v3 entropy-normalization error, excluded the false face-bias and unconditional-rate claims, handled zero empirical cells by support reduction, and found no exact qid or theorem collision at the accepted tier. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Prove the finite-precision lemma giving polynomial total bit work for outward Sinkhorn dual evaluation and exact rational marginal repair, including accumulated-update, positivity, denominator-length, and exp/log precision budgets. EARLY KILL TEST: On the rational binary witness and a tied positive 3-by-3 table, construct outward dual enclosures and exact repairs as a decreases; stop or change the computation theorem if valid original-value brackets cannot be preserved with polynomial precision. STRONGEST-FORM DRAFT (unverified, gaps listed inside): <repo-root>/internal/presolve_drafts/pid_entropic_zero_set_collapse.md.
proposed_from.novelty_justification: {"claim_boundary":"Generic minimax, fixed-instance entropy selection, transport stability, and criterion-set inversion are supporting mathematics. Boundary-valid zero collapse is a population-target diagnostic. The proposal makes no claim of a new generic entropy principle, a new transport-stability frontier, a new criterion-set theory, an unconditional two-sided root-rate result, a directionally uniform face expansion, or a conclusion about the published UAS contour without a code audit.","closest_results":"The closest computational results are Altschuler--Weed--Rigollet's exact-real arithmetic approximation plus marginal rounding and Lemma 10, Proposition 13, and Theorem 4 of van Apeldoorn et al.'s ICALP 2021 finite-precision scaling analysis. The closest econometric result is Franguridi--Liu's regularized OT estimator and bootstrap.","strict_gap":"The proposed kernel is the missing composition theorem that converts inexact log-domain iterations into independently checkable outward bounds for the unregularized finite moment criterion after exact rational marginal repair. It must jointly certify directed transcendental and generalized-KL dual enclosures, accumulated-update error, retained-positive mass, exact feasibility, denominator growth, an iteration count, and a polynomial total bit-work ledger.","why_not_subsumed":"A scaling-residual guarantee supplies neither a lower enclosure for the original optimum nor exact feasibility after rounded transcendental evaluations. A feasible rounded plan supplies only an upper bound. The generalized-KL dual supplies a lower bound only after its exponentials and linear terms are evaluated outward and the regularization bias is charged. None of the inspected comparators proves the staged composition."}

seed_details.anchor_opened: The Introduction, Theorem 1 and Remark 1 on page 4, the marginal-rounding construction in Algorithm 2, and the proof of Lemma 7 on page 13 were read. The proof first obtains an approximately scaled matrix, truncates excessive rows and columns, and adds a rank-one deficit correction; its complexity statement counts arithmetic and gives only a brief bit-length remark.
seed_details.opportunity: Construct an end-to-end finite-precision Sinkhorn certificate that returns outward rational bounds for the original finite OT moment value and an exactly marginal-feasible rational repair, with a polynomial bound on precision, denominators, and total bit operations.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: After the marginal-residual estimate, replace exact-real objective evaluation by directed enclosures for every shifted log-sum-exp, exponential, logarithm, potential update, generalized-KL dual term, and repaired primal term; the certificate must remain outward after all accumulated errors.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for the pair \(\text{finite-precision Sinkhorn}+\text{outward original-value certificate}\) located van Apeldoorn et al. on inexact scaling and Blanchard et al. on local log-sum-exp error, but no inspected theorem composed them with exact rational repair and two-sided original-value brackets.
seed_details.cynical_objection: Immediate from Altschuler--Weed--Rigollet because their rounding lemma and bit-length remark already make Sinkhorn polynomial-time.
seed_details.rebuttal: Their result supplies an approximate feasible plan and an upper approximation to a linear OT value; it does not produce directed lower evaluation, exact rational repair after inexact transcendental updates, or an auditable bracket for the original norm-of-moment criterion.
seed_details.burned_reason: The sole supported angle exhausted after two revisions; remaining seeds were unsupported, refuted, or subsumed and switching would change the root claim.

seed_details.anchor_opened: The Introduction, Theorem 1 and its convex-analytic proof in Appendix A.1, Section 3.1, Remark 5, Algorithm 2, and the Conclusion were read. The paper turns marginal information into support-function OT identification, then regularizes directional OT values and bootstraps the resulting criterion, without characterizing its exact positive-temperature zero set.
seed_details.opportunity: Prove the minimax identity for the norm-plus-KL criterion, characterize its zero set as the product-coupling moment restriction for every positive entropy level, and derive the first-order KL selection functional on the entire unregularized minimizing set, including ties.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Interchange the outer direction and the coupling before taking the entropy limit, so the primary objective is the norm of a vector moment and its argmin need not be a linear-programming face.
seed_details.destination_search: The pair \(\text{vector-moment norm}+\text{vanishing-entropy face selection}\) was checked against Weed and Cominetti--San Martín; their central results concern a fixed linear objective and do not state the product-zero collapse or the KL coefficient over a norm-minimizing coupling set.
seed_details.cynical_objection: Immediate from KL nonnegativity and standard perturbation of a compact convex program.
seed_details.rebuttal: The identity and zero collapse are short, but the exact estimand change and the tied-set first-order coefficient correct how a published regularized identified-set procedure is interpreted; they are retained only as supporting results, not sold as a general entropy theorem.

seed_details.anchor_opened: The Introduction, Theorem 2.2 and its inversion proof on page 4, the likelihood-level construction in Section 2.1, and the Final Discussion were read. The paper gives nonasymptotic multinomial regions with controlled simplex coverage but does not propagate them through an optimization-defined identified set.
seed_details.opportunity: Propagate one simultaneous multinomial confidence event and certified numerical brackets through the finite OT moment criterion to obtain outer coverage and separation-based Hausdorff control on the same event.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace asymptotic uniform criterion control by a deterministic coupling-stability inequality that is uniform in \(\theta\) and valid at simplex boundaries, then add numerical tolerance on the conservative side of level-set inversion.
seed_details.destination_search: Chernozhukov--Hong--Tamer provides asymptotic criterion-set inversion, while Chafaï--Concordet and Malloy--Tripathy--Nowak provide finite multinomial regions; no inspected source composes exact marginal coverage with certified OT optimization error.
seed_details.cynical_objection: A routine continuous-mapping corollary of generic criterion-set theory.
seed_details.rebuttal: The contribution is the computable common-event statement: a boundary-valid marginal stability constant and outward numerical error enter one finite-sample inclusion and one explicit Hausdorff bound; it is nevertheless positioned as part of the certificate package rather than as a new general set-inference frontier.

seed_details.anchor_opened: The Introduction, the general delta-method setup in Section 3, the entropic-OT application in Section 6, and the concluding scope were read. The paper establishes fixed-regularization limit laws, efficiency, and bootstrap consistency, not honest adaptive recovery of an unregularized zero set.
seed_details.opportunity: Select entropy, numerical accuracy, set threshold, and directional threshold jointly by a multiscale rule while adapting to an unknown separation exponent.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Derive a uniform deterministic bias envelope across entropy levels before invoking stochastic comparisons, because positive entropy changes exact zero membership rather than merely smoothing an estimator.
seed_details.destination_search: Fixed-entropy bootstrap theory and regularization-dependent empirical bounds were found, but no usable uniform bias envelope near changing minimizing faces was verified.
seed_details.cynical_objection: A standard Lepskiĭ argument once regularized OT concentration is available.
seed_details.rebuttal: The missing uniform face-sensitive bias envelope is exactly what prevents a standard Lepskiĭ proof; the available fixed-instance expansion is insufficient.
seed_details.disposition: dropped after deepening because the required uniform bias theorem is unsupported and the presolve counterexample refutes the proposed directional frontier

seed_details.anchor_opened: The Introduction, Theorem 3.1 and Proposition 3.2 with their proof sketches, the computational discussion, and Section 5 were read. The paper gives multi-marginal causal partial identification and plug-in rates for quadratic objectives and explicitly notes finite-precision instability and exponential tensor size.
seed_details.opportunity: Give factor-graph-aware outward certificates for \(K\)-marginal vector-moment zero sets without materializing the dense coupling tensor.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the two-way rank-one deficit repair by a \(K\)-way exact rational repair that preserves all marginals and respects a graphical factorization.
seed_details.destination_search: Lin--Ho--Cuturi--Jordan and Haasler et al. occupy multi-marginal scaling and graph-structured message passing, while Gao--Ge--Qian occupies the causal MOT reduction; an exact factorized repair theorem was not located.
seed_details.cynical_objection: A routine replacement of matrices by tensors in the two-marginal certificate.
seed_details.rebuttal: Exact repair and outward message-passing error are genuinely different, but no polynomial representation theorem in \(K\) was verified.
seed_details.disposition: dropped because the factorized exact-repair step lacks a credible proof route and a dense-tensor theorem would be a routine extension

seed_details.anchor_opened: Section 3.1 and Algorithm 2 of the anchor were read together with its Conclusion; the routine fixes an entropy level and stops at an unspecified convergence criterion.
seed_details.opportunity: Certify a single annealed Sinkhorn path that returns valid original-value brackets at every temperature and supplies a data-independent stopping schedule.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Couple outward finite-precision enclosures across warm starts while keeping each temperature's repaired primal exactly feasible.
seed_details.destination_search: Chizat's Theorem 2.1 and Theorem 3.2 characterize annealed schedules, regularization paths, and relaxation error, and propose debiasing; only the outward-certificate component remains distinct.
seed_details.cynical_objection: Subsumed by Chizat's annealed Sinkhorn convergence and debiasing analysis.
seed_details.rebuttal: Outward certification is not subsumed, but that content is already the stronger first seed and annealing adds no theorem-level consumer value.
seed_details.disposition: dropped as subsumed by the selected certificate kernel

seed_details.anchor_opened: The Introduction, Theorem 1 and its double-counting proof, Proposition 2, the nonlinear-function discussion, and the outer-bound theorem were read. The optimality criterion averages volume over empirical types and does not address OT images.
seed_details.opportunity: Choose among exact multinomial covering collections to minimize the volume of the propagated OT outer set subject to finite-sample coverage.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: The double-counting argument must be replaced by an ordering of empirical types according to the volume of their nonlinear OT images, which depends jointly on both marginals.
seed_details.destination_search: No theorem connecting minimum-volume multinomial regions to minimum-volume identified-set images was found, but even monotonicity of the image-volume objective is unclear.
seed_details.cynical_objection: The image of the smallest simplex region need not be the smallest parameter region, so the proposed optimality has no valid ordering principle.
seed_details.rebuttal: No defensible replacement principle was derived.
seed_details.disposition: dropped because the red-team objection holds

seed_details.anchor_opened: The Introduction, the rational-input and fixed-point computational model in Section 2.4, the inexact Sinkhorn updates in Section 3, and Theorem 4.7 on finite-precision scaling tests were read. The result controls scaling residual, not original OT value certification.
seed_details.opportunity: Derive a matching lower bound on the precision bits required by any outward certificate as temperature and target width vanish.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Construct two rational OT instances whose exact values straddle a reporting threshold but whose rounded exponential kernels agree below a critical precision.
seed_details.destination_search: Matrix-scaling query lower bounds and finite fixed-point upper bounds were found, but no value-certificate precision lower bound with a causal set-inversion consequence was located.
seed_details.cynical_objection: A numerical-analysis lower bound without a sharper estimator or identified-set theorem has little econometric content.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection is persuasive for this proposal's consumer, which needs a usable certificate rather than an impossibility frontier.

seed_details.anchor_opened: The Introduction, Proposition 1, Theorem 1 and its optimal-face localization proof, the Birkhoff lower bound, and the Conclusion were read. The paper quantifies entropic approximation of linear programs and identifies dependence on the suboptimality gap.
seed_details.opportunity: Define a critical entropy level at which a sharp zero-set point exits the regularized set.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the linear-program suboptimality gap by a moment-feasibility margin around the norm-minimizing coupling set.
seed_details.destination_search: Direct analysis of the product-relative KL criterion shows that the critical level is identically zero whenever the product coupling violates the moment.
seed_details.cynical_objection: The critical value is immediate: it is zero for every point not satisfying the product-coupling moment.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection holds; the exact collapse is recorded in the second seed instead of being inflated into a sensitivity frontier.
seed_details.disposition: dropped because the red-team objection holds
